title: Failed Paloma Top-Up & Bill Pay Orders: Retries and Destination Corrections
content:
Desk guidance for a Paloma Top-Up & Bill Pay order whose status is failed. The number of customer retries, whether a correction is allowed and how many, whether destination numbers are validated, and the period in calendar days after failure are the product's own settings.

## The rule

1. **Retry.** A failed order may be retried at the customer's request at most the product's number of customer-requested retries. A retry sends the order again, to the same destination or to a corrected one, and the order's status moves from failed back to processing.
2. **Correction — status.** A destination can be corrected only while the order is failed, as the order's status shows in Paloma's records.
3. **Correction — product and count.** A correction is possible only when the product allows destination correction, and at most the product's number of corrections per order, counted as the corrections logged on the order over its whole life.
4. **Correction — recording.** The corrected number is recorded exactly as the customer gives it, and is validated again when the product validates destination numbers.
5. **Time.** A retry or correction is accepted only within the product's period of calendar days after the order failed (the same period after which a failed order not retried is refunded automatically). The window is counted in calendar days from the date part of the moment the order failed, as recorded on the order, and an instruction on the last day is on time.
6. **After the window.** After that window, or when no retry is requested, the order is refunded under the refund rules of Paloma Top-Up & Bill Pay.

## Counting the window

The clock starts from the failure moment recorded on the order, not from the date the customer noticed the failure. Only its date part is used: the last day of the window is the failure date plus the product's number of calendar days. An instruction on any day up to and including that last day is on time; an instruction on the day after it is not accepted.

**Boundary cases (hypothetical dates; a period of 3 calendar days is assumed for illustration).**

| Failure recorded | Last day of the window | Instruction given | Accepted? |
|---|---|---|---|
| 10 March at 23:50 | 13 March | 13 March at 18:00 | yes — on the last day |
| 10 March at 23:50 | 13 March | 14 March at 08:00 | no — after the window |
| 10 March at 00:05 | 13 March | 13 March at 23:30 | yes — only the date part of the failure moment counts |

## Points of judgement

- An order whose status is processing or delivered is not failed, so its destination cannot be corrected.
- An order on which one correction is already logged, under a product that allows at most 1 correction per order, cannot be corrected again.
- A corrected number on a Paloma Bill Pay Utilities order, a product whose destination numbers are validated, is validated again.
